card.name: Words just before harm or safety terms
card.fires_on: Scattered words in safety-related passages, where a harm, injury, toxicity or adverse-reaction word is likely to come next. Examples are soften (the impact), Withdraw(al), injured or, and parts of drug names before toxicity.

modes.label: Injury and hazard wording
modes.description: Verbs or links in sentences about injury, impact, fire or stress.
modes.example: Make certain there is a carpet or rug beneath the crib or changing table to<< soften>> the impact if an infant falls.

modes.label: Drug names before toxicity or adverse reactions
modes.description: Final pieces of drug names or exposure words in interaction warnings.
modes.example: -administering INGREZZA or INGREZZA SPRINKLE with digoxin. Increased digoxin exposure may increase the risk of<< exposure>>-related adverse reactions.
